description: Source code implementing the 'last-modified' command in Git, which computes the last modification times of files across commits, using diff and revision traversal.

methods.name: last_modified_entry_hashcmp
methods.description: Comparison function for hashing last_modified_entry objects based on their path.

methods.name: active_paths_for
methods.description: Retrieves or allocates a bitmap representing active paths for a given commit.

methods.name: active_paths_free
methods.description: Frees the bitmap associated with a commit's active paths.

methods.name: last_modified_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the last_modified structure, including clearing hashmaps and freeing memory.

methods.name: add_path_from_diff
methods.description: Callback to add file paths from diff output into the last_modified paths hashmap.

methods.name: populate_paths_from_revs
methods.description: Populates the list of paths from the specified revisions by diffing against an empty tree.

methods.name: last_modified_emit
methods.description: Outputs the last modification info for a given path and commit.

methods.name: mark_path
methods.description: Marks a path as changed if it matches the specified object ID and emits its info.

methods.name: last_modified_diff
methods.description: Diff callback that processes file changes and marks paths accordingly.

methods.name: pass_to_parent
methods.description: Transfers active path bits from a commit to its parent.

methods.name: maybe_changed_path
methods.description: Determines if a path may have changed based on bloom filters and commit graph.

methods.name: process_parent
methods.description: Processes a parent commit, diffing if necessary, and propagating active paths.

methods.name: last_modified_run
methods.description: Performs the main traversal to compute last modification times across commits.

methods.name: last_modified_init
methods.description: Initializes the last_modified structure, setting up revisions and paths.

methods.name: cmd_last_modified
methods.description: Main command function for 'git last-modified', parsing options, initializing, running, and cleaning up.
